remarks: Welcome to the hunting honey hole! This 150.5 acre property is almost entirely wooded, has a year round stream, and plenty of trails that provide great access throughout.  The terrain is extremely diverse and ranges from level to fairly steep,  and everything in between. A recent selective timber harvest has created plenty of cover for both big and small game alike.  The residual forest consists of mainly red oak, soft maple, hard maple, and basswood with areas of plantation pine and hemlock. The quality of the remaining stock is very high (particularly in the red oak) and should make for a good long term investment.  Several thick bedding areas are located on the property as well. All of these combined attributes makes for an exceptional hunting and recreational property. Into fishing? This piece is located just a few minutes from the famed Genessee River known for its’ incredible trout fishing. If you enjoy winter recreation, one of many snowmobile trails in the area runs through the property. Whether you enjoy hunting, hiking, fishing, ATV riding or snowmobiling, it’s all close at hand with this property! This secluded sportsman’s paradise does not have electric available and oil, gas and mineral rights have been previously reserved. A hunting rights reservation on the eastern 52.7 acre portion of this property goes with the small log cabin adjacent to this property on Gordon Brook. However, a right of first refusal to purchase that property (1.75 acres with the log cabin) if it goes on the public market comes with the land for sale as well.
